title: A meaningful effort towards promoting the promotion of the official language Hindi.
description: On August 18, 2026, the Nagar Rajbhasha Karyanwani Samiti (Narakas), under the auspices of South Goa, successfully organized the 'State-Level Hindi Essay Writing Competition' for officials and employees of central offices, initiatives, banks, and autonomous bodies located in Goa. Participants from various offices in Goa enthusiastically participated and showcased their creativity and Hindi writing talent.

title: Exploring India's Polar Presence & Deep-Ocean Frontiers
description: NCPOR hosted senior Naval officers as a part of the Advanced Hydrography Course on 18 August 2026. Dr. Rahul Mohan, Scientist G & Director-in-Charge, highlighted India's presence in the polar regions, while Dr. Sunil Vadakkepuliyambatta, Scientist E outlined NCPOR's endeavours in deep-ocean exploration and mapping.

title: AFoPS, SCAR and IASC Strengthen Cooperation in Polar Research.
description: Dr. Thamban Meloth, Director, NCPOR, and Chair of the Asian Forum for Polar Sciences (AFoPS), signed a renewed MoU between SCAR and IASC on the sidelines of the SCAR Delegates Meeting in Oslo on 17 August 2026. The renewed partnership will strengthen joint research initiatives and facilitate shared use of polar research infrastructure.

title: INDIA at 39th SCAR DELEGATES MEETING 2026
description: Dr. Thamban Meloth, Director, NCPOR, represented India at the 39th SCAR Delegates Meeting, held in Oslo, Norway, from 17-19 August 2026. Delegates discussed urgent warning signals emerging from Antarctica and the need for coordinated global action ahead of IPY-5.

title: NCPOR at 12th SCAR Open Science Conference, Oslo, Norway
description: NCPOR researchers actively participated in the 12th SCAR Open Science Conference 2026 in Oslo, Norway. Representing NCPOR, Dr. Sarat Chandra Tripathy, Dr. Vikram Goel, Dr. Juhi Yadav, Mr. Sunil Kumar and Ms. Anirjita Das presented their research across two convened sessions on Antarctic extreme events and Southern Ocean boundary dynamics.

title: NCPOR at the 38th COMNAP AGM, Tromso, Norway
description: NCPOR represented India at the 38th Annual General Meeting of COMNAP in Tromso, Norway from 4-6 August 2026. Dr Shailendra Saini, Vice-Chair of COMNAP, represented India in the organisation's leadership, while Dr Yogesh Ray and Dr Anand K. Singh led sessions on science facilitation and critical technologies.

title: Celebrating 80th Independence Day 2026, NCPOR.
description: Marking 80 years of India's Independence, NCPOR celebrated the nation's enduring legacy and spirit of exploration. The celebration began with the National Song, followed by the unfurling of the Tricolour by Dr. Thamban Meloth, Director, NCPOR.

title: BRICS Working Group Meeting on Ocean and Polar Science & Technology.
description: India hosted the BRICS Working Group Meeting on Ocean and Polar Science & Technology (OPST) in Goa from 12-14 August 2026, convened by NCPOR. Dr. Thamban Meloth chaired the meeting, and the inaugural session featured a keynote on India's Blue Economy Initiatives by Dr. Madhavan Nair Rajeevan.

title: Strengthening India's Marine Geoscience Capabilities.
description: NCPOR and the Marine & Coastal Survey Division, Geological Survey of India, signed an MoU on 10 August 2026 to advance collaborative marine geoscientific research under the Indian EEZ Programme, focusing on seamount exploration and submarine geohazard studies.

title: Deciphering Earth's Deepest Gravity Dent
description: NCPOR convened a strategic brainstorming session on 'Deep-Ocean Geophysical Observations & Future Directions of the IOGL Programme' on 30 July 2026, featuring experts from IITs, IISc Bangalore, CSIR-NGRI and ISRO-SAC, chaired by Prof. M. Radhakrishna, IIT Bombay.

title: Exploring Scientific Collaboration
description: NCPOR welcomed a team from OGS Italy and the University of Padova on 3 August 2026. Director Dr. Thamban Meloth and NCPOR senior scientists discussed advancing collaborative research on marine landslides, geohazards, and ocean sciences.

title: Superannuation Ceremony | Sh. Ganesh Chandvale
description: NCPOR bid a warm farewell on superannuation to Sh. Ganesh Madan Chandvale, Scientific Assistant (Southern Ocean Group), after nearly 27 years of dedicated service in Research Vessel Operations, Seabed Mapping and the Southern Ocean Program.

title: Advancing Research on Submarine Geohazards
description: NCPOR hosted a brainstorming session on 'Understanding Submarine Slope Failures along the Indian Continental Margins' on 31 July 2026, chaired by Prof. M. Radhakrishna, bringing together experts from GSI, ONGC, MANIT Bhopal and CSIR institutions.

title: Indian delegation attended the 31st Session of the Assembly meeting of the International Seabed Authority (ISA)
description: An Indian delegation comprising Shri Mayank Joshi, Prof. Sandip Kumar Mukhopadhyay and Dr. Parijat Roy, Scientist F, NCPOR, attended the 31st Session of the ISA Assembly held from 27-31 July 2026 at Kingston, Jamaica.

title: Strengthening regional collaboration for a resilient Himalayan future.
description: Dr. Thamban Meloth, Director, NCPOR, represented India at the Regional Dialogue on Permafrost Research in the Hindu Kush Himalaya, held on 30-31 July 2026 at ICIMOD, Kathmandu, Nepal, with experts from Bhutan, China, India, Nepal, and Pakistan.

title: NCPOR participated in PRITHVI 2026
description: NCPOR participated in PRITHVI 2026, the Palaeoscience Film Festival of India, hosted by BSIP, Lucknow, from 23-25 July 2026, showcasing four documentary films highlighting polar sciences and expeditions.

title: Exploring Antarctica beyond the ice
description: Dr. Rahul Mohan, Scientist-G & Group Director, NCPOR, delivered a lecture on 'Antarctica: Geopolitics, Science and Environment' at the National Defence College, New Delhi, on 22 July 2026, to 100+ participants including international delegates from 41 countries.

title: Honouring the Legacy of Prof. Rohini Godbole.
description: NCPOR hosted a special screening of 'All That Matters', a documentary celebrating the life of Padma Shri Prof. Rohini Godbole, a pioneering particle physicist and advocate for gender equality in science.

title: Hearty Congratulations to Dr. Srinivasa Kumar Tummala on his appointment as Secretary, Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India.
description: NCPOR extends its congratulations to Dr. Srinivasa Kumar Tummala on his appointment as Secretary, Ministry of Earth Sciences, citing his extensive experience in remote sensing, satellite oceanography and ocean sciences.

title: Exploring the Arctic, Advancing Science!
description: The 17th Indian Arctic Expedition - Summer Team at Himadri Station in Svalbard is exploring how Arctic microbes, plants, and marine ecosystems respond to a changing climate. Participating institutes include NCPOR, Pondicherry University, Amity University Noida, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University and NRSC-ISRO.

title: Strengthening India-New Zealand Collaboration in Antarctica.
description: NCPOR and the University of Canterbury, New Zealand, signed an MoU to foster collaborative research, academic exchange, and innovation in Antarctic research.

title: NCPOR had the privilege of hosting an engaging talk by Ramcharan Vijayaraghavan.
description: NCPOR hosted a talk by Ramcharan Vijayaraghavan titled 'Stories on Ice: A Visual Journey through the Arctic, Antarctic and the Third Pole', highlighting polar education and science communication ahead of the 5th International Polar Year.

title: Dr. Bishakhdatta Gayen, Associate Professor, CAOS, IISc Bangalore, visited NCPOR.
description: Dr. Bishakhdatta Gayen delivered a talk on 'The Ice-Ocean Boundary Layer: The Final Gateway to Antarctic Ice-Shelf Melting', explaining the role of meltwater buoyancy and turbulence in regulating heat transfer at the ice-ocean interface.

title: International Yoga Day 2026 celebrations, the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
description: NCPOR organized a special yoga session led by Dr. Rakshitha S. Nayak on the theme 'Yoga for Healthy Ageing'. International Yoga Day was also celebrated at Ny-Alesund, Svalbard, by Indian expedition members stationed at Himadri.

title: Strengthening Indo-Norwegian Arctic Research Collaboration.
description: An online meeting was convened between the Norwegian Polar Institute and NCPOR to explore collaborative opportunities in the Arctic, focusing on Kongsfjorden, Svalbard, including carbon budget assessments and sea-ice modelling.

title: Mental well-being is essential for a healthy and productive workplace.
description: NCPOR hosted a Mental Health Awareness Lecture delivered by Dr. Arpita Sirsikar, Consultant Psychiatrist, IPHB, Bambolim, encouraging open conversations on mental health and reducing stigma.

title: NCPOR Signs MoA for Development of India's First Dedicated Polar and Ocean Museum at NCPOR, Goa.
description: NCPOR signed a Memorandum of Agreement with Creative Media Designers, Kolkata, a subsidiary of NCSM, for the development of India's first dedicated Polar and Ocean Museum, featuring an immersive Polar Science Gallery and Science on a Sphere theatre.

title: Dr. Rahul Mohan, Scientist-G & Group Director (Polar Sciences), NCPOR Goa, delivered a keynote talk.
description: Dr. Rahul Mohan delivered a keynote on 'Reorganisation of Southern Ocean Productivity Across Fronts During Glacial Periods' at the 30th Indian Colloquium on Micropaleontology and Stratigraphy at IIT Bhubaneswar.

title: Dr. Manish Tiwari, Scientist-F & Group Director (Arctic Operations), NCPOR, presented his research.
description: Dr. Manish Tiwari presented research on the application of Machine Learning in paleoceanography at the 30th Indian Colloquium on Micropaleontology and Stratigraphy, IIT Bhubaneswar.

title: World Environment Day 2026 | Tree Plantation.
description: The event concluded with a tree plantation drive at NCPOR, bridging scientific understanding and climate action as part of World Environment Day 2026 celebrations.
